rows.issuingAuthority: Kansas Judicial Council (kjc.ks.gov), which publishes the Kansas expungement petition, order and notice forms
rows.intendedPacketRole: the petition, order and notice for an adult conviction expungement under K.S.A. 21-6614
rows.finding: SIF-2 asked this lane to reconcile the Kansas corpus against the registry by SHA-256 rather than by formNumber string. That reconciliation cannot be run: all ten Kansas registry records carry artifactSha256 null and heldPath null, so there is no registry digest on either side to compare, and the intersection of registry digests with the three held Kansas digests is empty because the registry set is empty. The truncation SIF-2 predicted is real and worse than described — one held Kansas entry has its formNumber reduced to the four letters 'KSJC' — but truncation is not why the match fails. What does reconcile is title plus revision, and on that basis two of the three held Kansas documents bind to registry ids exactly: KS-NOTICE-OF-HEARING-ON-PETITION-FOR-EXPUNGEM (REV-2016-12) to KSJC-NOTICE-OF-HEARING-12-2016, and KSJC (REV-2022-08, 5 pages, 55 AcroForm fields, 'order-for-expungement-of-conviction-or-diversion') to KSJC-ORDER-FOR-EXPUNGEMENT-CONVICTION-OR-DIVERSION-08-2022. The third, KS-ORDER-OF-EXPUNGEMENT-OF-CONVICTION-OR-DIVE (REV-2016-12), matches the 12-2016 date of KSJC-ORDER-EXPUNGEMENT-COVER-SHEET-12-2016 but not its title — the held document is the order, the registry id is a cover sheet — so it is left unbound rather than forced. Two Kansas registry records — KS-CRIMINAL-COVER-SHEET-10-14-2025 and KSJC-PETITION-EXPUNGEMENT-CONVICTION-OR-DIVERSION-08-2022 — sit in LICENSE_PERMISSION_REVIEW. The form is public and its publisher restricts commercial reuse. That is a counsel and business decision, recorded here and not resolved here, and no clerk is asked about it.
